00-handbook-collage: Izingadi ze-permaculture zisebenza: ummbila, izithelo, imibhede efakwe i-mulch, ikhaya elisebenza ngamandla elanga nesivuno semifino.
06-food-forest-durban: I-food forest yezindawo ezifudumele ibonwa ngaphezulu: ubhanana, isihlahla sezithelo esisencane, izihlahlana ne-groundcover, kungekho mhlabathi ongamboziwe.
07-swale-dug-by-machine: I-swale ende imbiwa ngomshini, kunenduku yokulinganisa (survey staff) egcina izinga liqondile.
07-runoff-dam: Idamu le-runoff esiqongweni sendawo libamba amanzi ageleza ehla esigodini.
07-pond-filled: Ichibi elifanayo, elibekelwe ngepulasitiki, emasontweni ambalwa kamuva, ligcwele ngemva kwemvula enkulu.
07-sand-dam-lesotho: Idamu lesihlabathi elinqamula umfula wesihlabathi ogeleza ngezikhathi ezithile.
11-stone-house-bethel: Isakhiwo samatshe nodaka (cob) esinamaphaneli elanga nembobo yomoya ophahleni: ikhaya elaklanyelwa ilanga.
11-biogas-digester-build: Ukwakha i-biogas digester yomuzi: ithangi lihlala emgodini obiyelwe ngamabhulokhi.
